# Al-Manar College Schedule System

Welcome to the AI-browsable interface of Al-Manar College Schedule System (نظام جداول منار الذكي).

## Information and Resources

- [App Home Page](https://almanar-schedule-system.onrender.com/) - The student portal dashboard.
- [Instructions](https://almanar-schedule-system.onrender.com/instructions) - How to use the portal.
- [Student Login](https://almanar-schedule-system.onrender.com/login) - Standard portal login.
- [Teacher Login](https://almanar-schedule-system.onrender.com/teacher-login) - Faculty login portal.

## Overview
This platform manages real-time lecture timetables, notification streams, representative announcements, and QR-based attendance tracking for Al-Manar College students and lecturers.
